paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan, son of Rabbi Chanina.

Mentioned in Sanhedrin 38b, expounding that the day had twelve hours: in the first hour his dust was gathered, etc. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chama, son of Rabbi Chanina, or Rabbi Acha, son of Rabbi Chanina.

notes.text: Hyman records Chama and Acha as alternative readings for Yochanan; none is adopted as a canonical identity.
The consulted Sanhedrin names Rabbi Yochanan bar Chanina. The two alternative names in Dikdukei Soferim are given as Hyman reports them.
